dialect.guess: IBM Enterprise COBOL (or compatible mainframe COBOL, possibly Fujitsu/NEC for Japanese environment)
evidence: RECORDING MODE F (IBM mainframe file descriptor clause)
ENVIRONMENT-NAME / ENVIRONMENT-VALUE SPECIAL-NAMES (IBM-style environment variable access)

purpose.summary: This batch program (ICKE0270) is part of a Japanese insurance system (INS-CALI) and performs editing and output of a 'joint pool list' (共同プールリスト). It reads master and transaction files, merges/compares them by key, and writes results to multiple CSV and fixed-format output files, also calling a database handler subprogram to retrieve insurance company information.

notable_features: Japanese comments and system names (INS-CALIシステム, 共同プールリスト編集)
ORGANIZATION IS CSV (non-standard vendor extension for CSV file handling)
ENVIRONMENT-NAME / ENVIRONMENT-VALUE for environment variable access
CALL to subprogram KY0011S (database handler routine)
COPY directives for record layouts (KE0014C.CPY, JS0031C.CPY, KY0005C.CPY)
Debugging lines prefixed with 'D' (COBOL-85 debugging lines)
Multiple output files including CSV outputs
verdict.notes: The file is clearly production COBOL from a Japanese insurance system maintained over more than a decade. The ORGANIZATION IS CSV clause is a vendor extension (likely Fujitsu NetCOBOL or similar Japanese mainframe/open COBOL environment). COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown here. The 'D' prefix on DISPLAY statements indicates COBOL-85 debugging lines. Some working-storage and linkage section details are in the copybooks and not visible in this excerpt.
